tools.name: aggregate_audit_events
tools.description:
Compute aggregated metrics over v2 audit events (OCSF) for the current organization. Returns a single numeric value and optional grouped breakdown.

Metrics: 'count' (total events), 'unique_actors' (distinct users), 'unique_resources' (distinct resources).
Group by: 'activity_id', 'actor_user_uid', 'application_id', 'class_uid', 'day', 'hour', 'resource_type'.

All the same OCSF filters from get_audit_events are available (class_uid, status, severity, actor, etc.).

Example use cases:
- Active end-users in a time range: metric=unique_actors
- Active builders: metric=unique_actors, class_uid=6002 (APPLICATION_LIFECYCLE)
- API executions by day: metric=count, class_uid=6003, status!=99, group_by=day

IMPORTANT — API execution double-counting: API execution events (class_uid=6003) are logged as start/completion pairs. To count unique executions, filter to status != 99 (exclude IN_PROGRESS).

Time range is capped at 366 days.

application_id.description: Filter by application ID. Returns both lifecycle and execution events for the given app.

class_uid.description: OCSF class UID filter. Valid values: 3001=ACCOUNT_CHANGE, 3002=AUTHENTICATION, 3004=ENTITY_MANAGEMENT, 3005=USER_ACCESS_MANAGEMENT, 6002=APPLICATION_LIFECYCLE, 6003=API_ACTIVITY. Use list_audit_event_types for the full catalog.

resource_type.description: Filter by resource type. Common values: API, Application, Billing, Credential, File, Folder, Group, Integration, Knowledge, Organization, Permission, Profile, Repository, Role, Session, Token, User. Use list_audit_event_types for the full catalog.

search.description: Free-text search over audit event payloads.

status.description: OCSF status filter (0=UNKNOWN, 1=SUCCESS, 2=FAILURE, 99=IN_PROGRESS). For API execution events (class_uid=6003), each execution emits a start event (status_id=99) and a completion event (status_id=1 or 2). To count unique executions, exclude status_id=99.

tools.name: find_apps_by_package
tools.description: Find apps whose package usage index contains a package dependency. Supports filtering by deployed/non-deployed commits, declared or resolved version, and dependency source (root, direct, transitive).

package_version.description: Filter by declared version string/range from package.json.

package_version_resolved.description: Filter by resolved version from lockfile (e.g. '1.2.3').

dependency_source.description: Filter by dependency source: 'root' (root package.json), 'direct' (any non-transitive), 'transitive' (lockfile-only).

include_transitive.description: When false, excludes transitive (lockfile-only) dependencies. Defaults to true.

tools.name: get_application_deployment_history
tools.description: Fetch the deployment timeline for a Superblocks application. Returns deploy and undeploy events in reverse chronological order, including who performed each action and when. Undeploy entries have a null commitId. Supports either app_url or application_id plus base_url.

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return per page. Defaults to 50. Maximum 200.

offset.description: Number of items to skip before returning results. Defaults to 0.

tools.name: get_application_structure

tools.name: get_application_summary
tools.description: Fetch a Superblocks application summary, including the owning organization ID, app mode, deployed commit ID when available, and resolved environment. Provide either app_url or application_id plus base_url.

tools.name: get_audit_events
tools.description:
Fetch v2 audit events (OCSF) for the current organization in a time range, with cursor pagination and OCSF filters. Use list_audit_event_types to discover all available class_uid, resource_type, and operation values for filtering.

IMPORTANT — API execution double-counting: API execution events (class_uid=6003) are logged as start/completion pairs. Each execution produces two events with the same timestamp: a start event (status_id=99, no duration) and a completion event (status_id=1 for success or status_id=2 for failure, includes duration in ms). To count unique executions, filter to status_id != 99 (i.e. exclude IN_PROGRESS) or divide the raw class_uid=6003 count by 2.

application_id.description: Filter by application ID. Returns both lifecycle and execution events for the given app.

class_uid.description: OCSF class UID filter. Valid values: 3001=ACCOUNT_CHANGE, 3002=AUTHENTICATION, 3004=ENTITY_MANAGEMENT, 3005=USER_ACCESS_MANAGEMENT, 6002=APPLICATION_LIFECYCLE, 6003=API_ACTIVITY. Use list_audit_event_types for the full catalog.

status.description: OCSF status filter (0=UNKNOWN, 1=SUCCESS, 2=FAILURE, 99=IN_PROGRESS). For API execution events (class_uid=6003), each execution emits a start event (status_id=99) and a completion event (status_id=1 or 2). To count unique executions, exclude status_id=99.

resource_type.description: Filter by resource type. Common values: API, Application, Billing, Credential, File, Folder, Group, Integration, Knowledge, Organization, Permission, Profile, Repository, Role, Session, Token, User. Use list_audit_event_types for the full catalog.

search.description: Free-text search over audit event payloads.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous get_audit_events response.

tools.name: get_auth_status

tools.name: get_billing_plan_summary

tools.name: get_billing_usage_daily
tools.description: Get daily AI credit usage for a date range. Returns one row per day with the total credits consumed. Requires billing:manage permission.

start_date.description: Start date for the billing period (YYYY-MM-DD).

end_date.description: End date for the billing period (YYYY-MM-DD).

tools.name: get_billing_usage_records
tools.description: Get AI credit billing usage records for a date range. App filters scope app-attributed ledger records and app aggregates; per-user records remain date-scoped unless no app filter is provided. Requires billing:manage permission.

application_id.description: Optional application ID to filter app-attributed billing usage.

end_date.description: End date for the billing period (YYYY-MM-DD).

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return per page. Defaults to 50. Maximum 200.

offset.description: Number of items to skip before returning results. Defaults to 0.

start_date.description: Start date for the billing period (YYYY-MM-DD).

usage_type.description: Optional usage type filter for app-attributed billing usage.

tools.name: get_chat_messages
tools.description: Fetch persisted builder/editor user chat messages for a Superblocks application. Supports bounded pagination with an opaque cursor and optional filtering by sender user ID.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous get_chat_messages response.

tools.name: get_current_user
tools.description: Get details about the currently authenticated Superblocks user for a given base_url.

tools.name: get_integration
tools.description: Get a Superblocks integration by ID, including configuration metadata when available.

tools.name: get_integration_access
tools.description: List all users and groups that have access to a Superblocks integration, including their roles and permissions. Provide integration_id plus base_url.

tools.name: get_job_access
tools.description: List users and groups that have access to a scheduled job, including role and permission details.

tools.name: get_knowledge
tools.description: Get a single knowledge entry (fact) by ID, including its full content. Knowledge entries are persistent notes and instructions that Clark uses when building apps.

knowledge_id.description: The ID of the knowledge entry.

tools.name: get_user_permissions
tools.description: Get all resources a user can access and their role on each, including assignments inherited through groups. Returns RBAC assignments across applications, integrations, workflows, and jobs. Useful for deprovisioning audits, compliance reviews, and access certification.

tools.name: get_workflow_access
tools.description: List users and groups that have access to a workflow, including role and permission details.

tools.name: grant_resource_access
tools.description: Create RBAC assignments for a resource (roles or direct permissions). Organization scope is always the authenticated user's current organization (matches server enforcement).

assignment_id.description: Role ID or permission ID depending on assignment_type.

resource_type.description: RBAC resource type (for example: apps, integrations, workflows, jobs).

tools.name: list_applications
tools.description: List all Superblocks applications the current user can access. Supports filtering by creation/update date range, name substring, creator email, deploy status, and application mode.

application_mode.description: Filter by application mode. Only "2.0" (Clark AI Apps) is supported. When set, excludes legacy 1.0 apps from results.

is_deployed.description: Filter by deploy status (true = deployed, false = not deployed).

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return per page. Defaults to 50. Maximum 200.

name_contains.description: Case-insensitive substring match on application name.

offset.description: Number of items to skip before returning results. Defaults to 0.

tools.name: list_audit_event_types
tools.description: Returns the full catalog of audit event types emitted by Superblocks. Use this to discover valid class_uid, resource_type, and operation values for filtering with get_audit_events. No API call is made — this is a static reference.

tools.name: list_billing_usage_limits
tools.description: List configured AI usage limits for the current organization, including per-user/default user limits and the enterprise org-wide overage limit when available. Requires billing:manage permission.

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return per page. Defaults to 50. Maximum 200.

offset.description: Number of items to skip before returning results. Defaults to 0.

tools.name: list_builder_seats
tools.description: List builder seats for the current organization.

tools.name: list_distinct_packages_in_org
tools.description: List the distinct set of packages declared across every application in the current org's package usage index. Inverse of find_apps_by_package: returns one row per package_name with the set of declared versions, the count of apps using it, the deployed subset, and a bounded sample of app IDs (≤10). Use this when reconciling the org's package footprint against an external registry or CVE feed.

package_name_prefix.description: Case-sensitive prefix match on package_name. '%' and '_' are treated as literal characters.

dependency_source.description: Filter by dependency source: 'root' (root package.json), 'direct' (any non-transitive), 'transitive' (lockfile-only).

include_transitive.description: When false, excludes transitive (lockfile-only) dependencies. Defaults to true.

deployed.description: Optional deploy filter. true = only the currently-deployed commit, false = only non-deployed commits, omitted = all indexed commits.

tools.name: list_folders
tools.description: List folders in the current organization, including IDs and metadata.

tools.name: list_integrations
tools.description: List all integrations (data sources, APIs, secret stores) configured in the current organization. Optionally filter by kind, creator email, or name substring.

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return per page. Defaults to 50. Maximum 200.

name_contains.description: Case-insensitive substring match on integration name.

offset.description: Number of items to skip before returning results. Defaults to 0.

tools.name: list_knowledge
tools.description: List knowledge entries (facts) for the current organization. Knowledge entries are persistent notes and instructions that Clark uses when building apps. Supports filtering by scope, access type, enabled status, and text search.

entity_scope.description: Scope of the knowledge entry: org, user, or integration.

access_type.description: Access type: always_inject (core memory) or on_demand (skills).

search.description: Search by name or description substring.

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return per page. Defaults to 50. Maximum 200.

offset.description: Number of items to skip before returning results. Defaults to 0.

tools.name: list_organization_agents
tools.description: List non-deactivated agents for the authenticated user's current organization. Organization scope matches auth (same as other MCP tools); organization_id is optional and only needed if you must target a specific org UUID for URL compatibility.

organization_id.description: Optional. When omitted, uses the authenticated user's current organization.

tools.name: list_packages_by_app
tools.description: List package dependencies indexed for a Superblocks application. Mirrors `find_apps_by_package` against the same usage index but pivots on the app: given an application_id, returns the packages declared in package.json (and optionally resolved from the lockfile) for one or more indexed commits. Supports filtering by deployed/non-deployed commits, specific commit, declared or resolved version, package name, and dependency source (root, direct, transitive).

commit_id.description: Optional commit ID. When provided, only packages from that commit are returned. By default, packages from all indexed commits of the app are returned.

package_version.description: Filter by declared version string/range from package.json.

package_version_resolved.description: Filter by resolved version from lockfile (e.g. '1.2.3').

dependency_source.description: Filter by dependency source: 'root' (root package.json), 'direct' (any non-transitive), 'transitive' (lockfile-only).

include_transitive.description: When false, excludes transitive (lockfile-only) dependencies. Defaults to true.

deployed.description: Optional deploy filter. true = only the currently-deployed commit, false = only non-deployed commits, omitted = all indexed commits.

tools.name: list_rbac_assignments
tools.description: List RBAC assignments for a resource by resource_type and resource_id (for example apps, integrations, workflows, jobs).

resource_type.description: RBAC resource type (for example: apps, integrations, workflows, jobs).

tools.name: list_roles
tools.description: List available RBAC roles for an organization, including their UUIDs. Use these role UUIDs as assignment_id when calling grant_resource_access. Optionally filter by role type (apps, integrations, org, jobs, workflows). Organization scope defaults to the authenticated user's current organization; pass organization_id only when targeting a different org you belong to.

organization_id.description: Optional. When omitted, uses the authenticated user's current organization.

type.description: Filter roles by type (apps, integrations, org, jobs, workflows).

tools.name: list_users
tools.description: List all users in a Superblocks organization with their status, type, and org-level role assignments. Useful for access audits, user inventories, and governance workflows.

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return per page. Defaults to 50. Maximum 200.

offset.description: Number of items to skip before returning results. Defaults to 0.

tools.name: list_users_by_role
tools.description: List users in a Superblocks organization filtered by org role name (e.g. Admin, Developer, End-User). Returns only users whose org-level role assignment matches the given role_name (case-insensitive). Useful for access audits and compliance reviews.

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return per page. Defaults to 50. Maximum 200.

offset.description: Number of items to skip before returning results. Defaults to 0.

role_name.description: Org role name to filter by (e.g. Admin, Developer, End-User). Case-insensitive.

tools.name: revoke_resource_access
tools.description: Delete a single RBAC assignment by assignment record ID.

assignment_record_id.description: Assignment record ID from RBAC assignments API.

tools.name: unassign_builder_seat
tools.description: Unassign a builder seat for a user by user_id.

tools.name: undeploy_application
tools.description: Take a deployed Superblocks application offline. The app becomes inaccessible to all users until redeployed. Supports either app_url or application_id plus base_url. Optionally pass a custom message for the audit trail.

message.description: Optional custom message for the undeploy audit trail. When omitted the server generates one automatically.

tools.description: Update a folder name by folder ID.

organization_id.description: Optional. When omitted, uses the authenticated user's current organization.

tools.name: update_resource_access
tools.description: Update a single RBAC assignment by assignment record ID.

assignment_record_id.description: Assignment record ID from RBAC assignments API.

assignment_id.description: Role ID or permission ID depending on assignment_type.

tools.name: update_user_billing_usage_limit
tools.description: Set a per-user AI usage limit override, or omit user_id to set the default per-user usage limit for the organization. Provide either credit_limit or amount_limit_cents. Requires billing:manage permission.

amount_limit_cents.description: Dollar-denominated usage limit in cents. Provide exactly one of amount_limit_cents or credit_limit.

credit_limit.description: Credit-denominated usage limit. Provide exactly one of credit_limit or amount_limit_cents.

tools.name: update_user_org_role
tools.description: Change a user's organization-level role (e.g. Admin, Developer, End-User). This uses the dedicated org user role endpoint, not the generic RBAC assignment API. Use list_roles with type='org' to find available role IDs. Requires org admin privileges.

role_id.description: Role ID (UUID) of the org-level role to assign. Use list_roles with type='org' to find available role IDs.

organization_id.description: Optional. When omitted, uses the authenticated user's current organization.
